_comment: Role mapping for the migration flow. No new contracts: each role is an existing justitia/plasma contract. Addresses are the justitia fork genesis CREATE addresses (zero-coinbase nonces 0..4).

token_wrapper.why: JRBase = ERC20 + Lockable: wraps the token with pledge/lock (lockCount/unlockCount/residePledge) - the wrapper that also carries the resource lock

router.note: the cross precompile (RpcContractAddr 0x...11101) hardcodes this address - it is CREATE-nonce 4 of the zero-coinbase genesis sequence

resources_delegation.why: permission/proposal delegation: issueWhileListProposal / issueContractProposal / issueChangeWhiteListProposal gate every registry and resource decision

plasma_child.role: plasma child chain (UTXO, JT mint 2x, depositChildChain)

mainnet_reference_roles._comment: verified 2026-11-27 on api.trongrid.io / api.shasta.trongrid.io. All live on MAINNET only, except the gen exchange account (TNvi) which exists on BOTH networks.

TAUV_wrapper.mainnet: EOA, 1267.0786 TRX, TRC10 holdings, no code

TQMvF_router.mainnet: CONTRACT 6548 B, ABI cleared, hidden selector 0x1129361d, deployed by TNvi (tx dd8947cb..)

TNvi_gen_exchange_account.mainnet: EOA, 23710.7971 TRX, 531236097331 USDT (531236.097331), ownerThr 1 self, active ops 7fff1fc0033ec30f
TNvi_gen_exchange_account.shasta: EOA, 4.000103 TRX, TRC10 1001540, same permissions, created 2026-04-24, funded by 41a4ff66/410b32c3/41a412e7
TNvi_gen_exchange_account.note: the only role living on both networks - the fork/shasta side that bridges to mainnet
